category_title: Students with high callous-unemotional (CU) traits and proactive aggression
minimal_context: The student is asked to start a workbook activity during a 15-minute classroom learning session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's begin our 15-minute classroom learning session. Please open your workbook and start the first activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing that. I'm going to keep talking to the others. I have difficulties stopping myself from doing or saying things.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to be quiet and focus on your own work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I told you, I can't! It's like having a 'stop button' in my head that does not work properly.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to sit still and concentrate on the workbook.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Screams and kicks the desk, displaying overloaded behavior) I don't care! I can't stop and I'm spiraling out of control!

task.content: Classroom learning sessions and inhibition training activities

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When experiencing difficulties in stopping himself thinking, doing or saying certain things
